scheduleAddOperator(address,address[],by.details: Membership is the heavy gate: a new operator must be admitted here before it can      self-register an attested key via `scheduleAttestedKeyRotation`. The new operator has      no attested key until it rotates one, so this only grows the membership set.

scheduleAttestedKeyRotation(address).details: The per-node, high-frequency, self-serve path: a CE generates a fresh ephemeral key on      every boot and rotates only its own slot. Writes are to a single, operator-keyed slot,      so two operators restarting concurrently produce distinct ops and disjoint slot writes;      neither clobbers the other's fresh key.      Double-gated, NO committee quorum:        1. attestation  - `newAttestedKey` must be eligible (caller first runs           `submitNodeAttestation` to prove it ran in a TEE matching an approved measurement).        2. operator self-auth - `msg.sender` must be an operator and may rotate only its OWN           slot, so no one can repoint another operator's seat. The operator EOA sending the           tx IS its authorization (the EOA must be funded).      The security-council veto window remains the backstop against an anomalous rotation.

returns.opId: The unique hash of the scheduled operation.

scheduleRiskManager(address,address[],by.details: The operation cannot be executed until `TIMELOCK_DELAY` has passed.

returns.opId: The unique hash of the scheduled operation.

scheduleSignerRotation((address,address).details: Used for membership-shaped changes (which operators contribute a signer, and the      quorum `k`). The signer set is global across all vaults, so there is no per-vault      routing here; execution fans out to every registered vault. For routine per-node key      refresh on restart use `scheduleAttestedKeyRotation`, which is race-free.      NB: excluding an operator's key here benches it, it is not an eviction. A benched      operator can re-add itself via `scheduleAttestedKeyRotation` (subject to the council      veto window). To durably evict, use `scheduleRemoveOperator` or revoke its measurement      profile (which clears key eligibility).
